playlist.playlist_description: Dallas Willard’s classic, “The Divine Conspiracy” was published in 1998 and was awarded Book of the Year by Christianity Today. A study in the Sermon on the Mount, it was subtitled, “Rediscovering Our Hidden Life in God.”  To make his message more accessible, this 12-part video series was funded through The Harvey Fellows 2007 Summer Institute under the title of "Text, Context and the Soul." The goal here is to present discipleship to Jesus as an interactive life in the Kingdom of God and the gospel (Good News!) for our life now. It is a life available to “whosoever will.”
